14.title: Ozymandias
14.note: Every moment in this summary is either a turning point itself (Hank's execution, Jesse taken hostage and tortured, Walt Jr. learning the truth, the knife struggle, Holly at the fire station, Walt taking a new identity) or is explicitly framed as its setup or aftermath (Walt packing before the fight, the barrels being dug up, Marie's news to Skyler). There is no inconsequential texture left in this episode's summary that could be shown to someone who hasn't watched it, so I'd rather return nothing than stretch rule 1.
